note: Official ESDC inputs (P-29). Never edit; a new edition is a new download with a new row. The LMIA application forms themselves (EMP5626 high-wage, EMP5627 low-wage, EMP5624, EMP5628, EMP5593) are NOT public: ESDC issues them only on request when LMIA Online cannot be used (canada.ca LMIA Online page, checked 21 Oct 2026); their catalogue pages say "The form does not exist".
